entities.name: Drive readable Semantic effects from a command
entities.summary: Compile one readable source stream and drive its reference execution with one strict bounded observation script.

acceptance: Readable source plus strict observations produces one canonical affine effect-run observation
Source admission precedes and gates observation-script reading
Wrong-typed and missing observations preserve one-shot request evidence
Usage and host failures never masquerade as semantic observations
Bun and Node emit byte-identical stdout
The command invokes only the reference interpreter

relations.summary: The accepted compiler remains the sole readable-source authority.
The accepted affine driver remains the sole observation-delivery authority.
The accepted process host and source observation behavior remain stable.
Adds a stateless readable-source affine effect adapter over the kernel.
